description: Repairs r-def-expr-sql/expr-bigint-stored-compare-convert: row ID 3 was never inserted and alias b collided with column B. Asks, over the same Bg rows (ID 3 as the literal 5), how BIGINT compares and converts: equality and range against 64-bit literals and 2^62 + 1 written three ways, ORDER BY B and B DESC, Min, Max and Count with aliases mn, mx and cn, Sum, Avg, GROUP BY B, and CStr, Str, Format, Hex, CDbl, CDec, CCur, CLng, CInt, CByte, CBool and CVar of B. Each is its own snapshot. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
